segments.oily: One long-term oily-skin reviewer (45) reports two months of nightly use with no visible difference.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe the serum as not drying despite being a retinol, with one mature/dry-skin user saying it did not dry her skin at all and another with dry, rosacea-prone skin saying other retinols dry her out but this one does not.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive/dry-combination skin reports no dryness or irritation and help with pimples and breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most often report tolerance without stinging, redness or breakouts when introduced gradually, though one sensitive-skin user had small bumps and peeling after only two nights.
segments.normal: A reviewer with medium complexion and no self-described sensitivity still had small bumps and peeling after two nights, later attributed to not introducing the product gradually.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s-70s) most commonly report softened forehead lines, smaller pores and firmer, glowing skin, with two saying they saw no change after two months of nightly use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report reduced fine lines and wrinkles, especially on the forehead and around the mouth, some within one to two weeks; two reviewers using it nightly for two months report no change in wrinkles or fine lines.
concerns.dehydration: Many say the formula is not drying and even feels hydrating or plumping; several others state that retinol dryness/flaking is expected at first and resolves once a routine is built up, and one reviewer stopped use because it dried her skin too much.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including ones with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin, report no redness or irritation; one non-sensitive reviewer had peeling and small bumps after only two nights of use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers generally describe the skin as tolerating the product well once introduced gradually, with mentions of smoother, more resilient-feeling skin; initial flaking or peeling is reported by a few during the first days.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report noticeably lighter dark spots, hyperpigmentation, sun spots or age spots within one to several weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers say breakouts and cystic acne stopped after switching to this retinol from others; however a few report a temporary 'purge' phase with new breakouts, and one reviewer had persistent, unbalancing breakouts and switched products.
concerns.oiliness: Only one long-term oily-skin reviewer comments, reporting no noticeable change in oiliness or other results after two months.

extraits.texte: I used this at night only. I was excited to use this but after 2 months no difference. I had the same issue with the multivitamin product. Will not be buying again. For reference I'm 45 and have always been oily.

This serum is absolutely amazing! I needed something to get rid of dark spots so I opted for a trial size first. My positive results started after a couple days and after a week, the dark spots are almost gone. I have tried to get rid of my post acne breakout hyperpigmentation spots for the longest time. I have tried spot treatments, serums, etc but nothing worked until this miracle product came around. My skin is so much smoother and it does not dry out my mature, dry skin. I 100% recommend this to everyone.

extraits.titre: Love this for my sensitive, rosacea skin
extraits.texte: I am a natural redhead, so pale, sensitive skin with rosacea is the normal. My skin is also very dry especially in the winter. This is one of two retinols that my skin not only tolerates, but loves. Twice now I have stopped using this to try other products (mostly because of price) but I always end up coming back to this one. My skin is smoother with little to no acne. Any other retinol dries me out and causes me to break out but not Dermalogica. I am so impressed by their retinol that I have bought some other products to try. Yes its pricey but I think its worth it!

extraits.titre: Great Retinol Serum for Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: I have pretty sensitive, dry/combination skin and this serum works really well without drying me out or causing irritation. I see a noticeable difference in the morning when I put it on the night before. I also find it helps a ton with any pimples or breakouts I experience. 10/10 would recommend this product!

I was using sunday riley retinol for a year and constant issues with breakouts and cystic acne whike using, as soon as i switched to dermalogica dynamic skin retinol the breakouts stopped and my skin started glowing. I pair this with the clearing serum and the collagen banking serum.
